events.title: Northwind starts a Phase 2 study of NW-101

sources.claim: NW-101 Phase 2 study has begun dosing in moderate asthma.
sources.snippet: Northwind Therapeutics today announced that the first participants have been dosed in its Phase 2 study of NW-101 in adults with moderate asthma.

revisions.note: First report of the study start.

events.title: Northwind completes enrollment in the NW-101 study

sources.claim: Enrollment for the NW-101 Phase 2 study is complete.
sources.snippet: Recruitment status: Active, not recruiting. Enrollment target reached.

sources.claim: Northwind finished enrolling its Phase 2 asthma study.
sources.snippet: Northwind has completed enrollment in the Phase 2 study of NW-101, with topline results expected in the first half of next year.

revisions.note: Sponsor release restates the same fact.

events.title: Northwind reports Phase 2 topline for NW-101 in moderate asthma

sources.claim: NW-101 met its primary endpoint, a change in lung function at week 12.
sources.snippet: NW-101 met the primary endpoint of improvement in lung function at week 12 compared with placebo, Northwind Therapeutics announced today.
sources.hl: met the primary endpoint of improvement in lung function at week 12

sources.claim: The Phase 2 study status changed to completed.
sources.snippet: Overall status: Completed. Primary completion reached for the NW-101 Phase 2 study.

sources.claim: Analysts called the lung-function improvement statistically significant.
sources.snippet: Shares rose after Northwind said NW-101 produced a statistically significant improvement in lung function in its mid-stage asthma trial.
sources.hl: statistically significant improvement in lung function

sources.claim: Topline was reported on 13 March.
sources.snippet: On Thursday Northwind disclosed topline data for NW-101, its mid-stage asthma candidate, with full results planned for a medical meeting.
sources.hl: On Thursday Northwind disclosed topline data

revisions.note: Registry status adds context, no new claim.
Wire coverage adds the significance claim.
A fourth report restates it, with a different day.

entities.name: Moderate asthma
entities.note: Matched from 'mid-stage asthma trial'; one source lacks the severity term.

events.note: Date reads 12 March (day precision). One source gives 'Thursday', published a day later, so the platform keeps both and shows the disagreement.

events.title: Northwind plans a Phase 3 discussion with regulators

sources.claim: Northwind intends to discuss Phase 3 design with regulators this year.
sources.snippet: Northwind expects to meet regulators on a Phase 3 design for NW-101 later this year, according to people familiar with the plan.
sources.hl: expects to meet regulators on a Phase 3 design

revisions.note: A single secondary report; no sponsor confirmation yet.

events.title: Halden Bio doses the first participant with HB-2207

sources.claim: HB-2207 has entered a first-in-human study.
sources.snippet: Halden Bio announced that the first participant has been dosed in the first-in-human study of HB-2207.

events.title: Halden Bio raises financing to advance HB-2207

sources.claim: Halden Bio raised new funding tied to HB-2207.
sources.snippet: Halden Bio has raised new capital that it said would fund the next stage of development of HB-2207.

sources.claim: The financing supports HB-2207 development.
sources.snippet: Proceeds will support the clinical development of HB-2207 in asthma.
sources.hl: support the clinical development of HB-2207

events.title: Halden Bio reports Phase 1 safety data for HB-2207

sources.claim: HB-2207 was well tolerated in the Phase 1 study.
sources.snippet: HB-2207 was generally well tolerated across dose levels, with no safety signals that would prevent further study.
sources.hl: generally well tolerated across dose levels

sources.claim: Halden reported a clean early safety profile.
sources.snippet: Halden Bio said early safety data for HB-2207 were clean, clearing the way for a mid-stage study.
sources.hl: early safety data for HB-2207 were clean

sources.claim: Cobalt Peak obtained rights to CP-418.
sources.snippet: Cobalt Peak Pharma has entered a license agreement giving it development rights to CP-418.
sources.hl: license agreement giving it development rights

events.title: Cobalt Peak starts a Phase 2 study of CP-418

sources.claim: A Phase 2 study of CP-418 is recruiting.
sources.snippet: Recruitment status: Recruiting. Phase 2, atopic dermatitis, CP-418.

sources.snippet: Cobalt Peak announced the start of dosing in its Phase 2 study of CP-418 in atopic dermatitis.

events.title: Cobalt Peak may have paused enrollment in the CP-418 study

sources.claim: The registry lists the study as suspended.
sources.snippet: Recruitment status: Suspended.

sources.claim: Cobalt Peak says enrollment continues.
sources.snippet: Enrollment in the CP-418 Phase 2 study is continuing as planned.

revisions.note: Sponsor statement conflicts; kept as a disagreement.

events.title: Meridian reports a Phase 3 interim analysis for MS-339

sources.claim: The interim analysis supported continuing the Phase 3 study.
sources.snippet: A planned interim analysis supported continuing the Phase 3 study of MS-339 without changes.

sources.claim: Meridian's study passed its interim look.
sources.snippet: Meridian Sciences said its late-stage asthma study passed a planned interim look.

events.title: Meridian updates the Phase 3 timeline for MS-339

sources.claim: The Phase 3 readout is now expected in the third quarter.
sources.snippet: Meridian now expects the Phase 3 readout for MS-339 in the third quarter.

events.title: Tessel Labs selects TL-5 as a development candidate

sources.claim: TL-5 is Tessel's development candidate.
sources.snippet: Tessel Labs has selected TL-5 as its development candidate for eosinophilic esophagitis.
sources.hl: selected TL-5 as its development candidate

sources.claim: A first-in-human study of TL-5 may have started.
sources.snippet: Tessel Labs is understood to have begun first-in-human dosing of TL-5, though the company has not confirmed.
